subject: Exclusive CodeCrafted roundtable — promo allocations & distribution plan
messages:
From: Sofia Patel <sofia@codecrafted.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Promo credits for our invite-only tech roundtable

Hi Hannah —

Thanks again for the quick intro call yesterday. CodeCrafted is running a two-hour invite-only roundtable (50 senior devs + 10 partner seats) on July 18th focused on low-latency inference patterns. We'd love to offer attendees a trial bundle to try Redwood after the event.

Quick ask: can Redwood provide a batch of attendee promo credits (trial tokens) and a few sponsor vouchers for our partner speakers? Ideally: 60 attendee codes (two-week trial, 50k token cap) + 5 speaker upgrades (1-month, 200k token cap). We can handle distribution — will pick attendees from RSVP list.

Attached is a simple CSV template with how we plan to distribute codes, plus a draft SOW for the co-marketing mention. Can you confirm whether Redwood can approve this allocation and any constraints we should note (rate limits, regional availability)?

Appreciate it — excited to get this running.

Best,
Sofia Patel
Partnerships Manager | CodeCrafted
sofia@codecrafted.io
[Attachment: promo_credit_template.csv (CSV)]
[Attachment: SOW-CodeCrafted-draft.pdf (PDF)]

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Patel <sofia@codecrafted.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jun 2025 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Promo credits for our invite-only tech roundtable

Hi Sofia —

Thanks for the details and the CSV. Quick yes in principle — this aligns with our partner events playbook. A couple of operational clarifications before we lock the codes in:

- Attendee codes: we can allocate 60 two-week trial codes with a 50k token soft limit. They'll come from our event promo bucket and will be single-use.
- Speaker upgrades: we can do 5 one-month upgrades but they need to be tied to a verified speaker email (we'll issue them as tenant upgrades, not transferable).
- Regional note: codes will be usable in US/EU regions; APAC availability needs a quick ops check (let me know if any attendees are APAC).
- Rate-limits: default per-tenant QPS applies; if you expect spiky demo traffic during the session we can enable a temporary burst policy — suggest you tell speakers to stagger live demos.

I'll loop in Partnerships ops (Marissa) and Growth ops (Ben) to approve the promo bucket and confirm delivery mechanics. Can you send the finalized RSVP list by July 8th? Once we have that we'll generate the CSV with codes and a short distribution guide.

Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Field Partnerships | Redwood Inference

Thanks,
Hannah
